page.layout: One column of running text, set in italic with roman quotation and Greek-free Latin. Below the last line: a signature mark "4" with an asterisk at the foot, left of centre. Catchword "umbra," at the right foot. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Occurrebant dum istæc cogito, ex adverso pauca quædam, nec aspernanda, quæ labentem animum nonnihil erigerent, cunctantemque subinde velut subjectis stimulis in hanc arenam propellerent. Optimi Regis judicium: crebri amicorum hortatus: vester multorum (ut illi submonebant, & ego haud inexpertus humanitatem vestram facile credebam) in me proni affectus. Pepulerunt ista fateor, (ut par erat) animum meum; quin & commoverunt: sed hactenus, ut tamen si meo unius arbitratu res statuenda foret, nec longa nec difficilis futura esset diliberatio. Quid enim? Paterer ne ego me ætate jam declivi, defectis viribus, memoriâ lubricâ, balbum & pertimidum senem, ex suavissimo quo perfruebar otio &

page.notes: The "4" with an asterisk at the foot is read as a gathering signature, not a page number, since it sits beside the catchword line. "Quid" is underlined in the print; underlining is not reproduced. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout. The word "diliberatio" is printed that way and is left as printed. The space in "Paterer ne" is read from the scan and may be a joined word. The final "&" is the printed ampersand ending the page before the catchword.
